ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure, with curved arrows indicating electron movement, but the problem requires ignoring them. On the left side is a benzoiodoxolactone skeleton: a benzene ring is connected to a carbonyl-containing lactone ring, and there is an iodine center in the ring; the iodine center is also connected to two hydroxy-like O-H ligands and is connected through an oxygen atom to the alkene fragment on the right side. In the right-side alkene fragment, the left alkene carbon bears an R1 substituent and is connected to O-I, and the right alkene carbon is connected to a carbon substituent environment bearing R2, R3, and H. Reasoning: According to the method draft, represent all R substituents with the wildcard *, and ignore the arrows. Starting from the alkene substituent, the left external R is denoted as *, and C=C and its stereochemical slashes are encoded as */C(=C/C(*)*)O. Then attach the iodine center; iodine connected to two hydroxyl groups and to the benzoiodoxolactone oxygen is written as OI1(O)(O)O. Finally encode the left fused lactone/benzene ring as C(=O)c2ccccc21, and close the iodine-containing ring with 1. Therefore the complete SMILES is */C(=C/C(*)*)OI1(O)(O)OC(=O)c2ccccc21.

method.method_draft: First transcribe only the atom-bond graph visible in the image, omitting the curved arrows. Start from the alkene substituent: encode the left external R group as `*`, then the C=C unit with the left vinylic carbon bonded to R1 and to an O-I group, and the right alkene carbon bonded to wildcard substituents corresponding to R2/R3/H-side carbon substituent pattern, giving the front fragment `*/C(=C/C(*)*)O`. Then append the iodine center attached to two hydroxyls and to the benziodoxolone oxygen as `I1(O)(O)O...`. Finally encode the fused lactone/benzene portion seen on the left as `C(=O)c2ccccc21`, closing the iodine-containing ring at `1`, yielding `*/C(=C/C(*)*)OI1(O)(O)OC(=O)c2ccccc21`.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中显示一个过渡态结构，弯曲箭头表示电子移动但题目要求忽略。左侧是苯并碘氧杂内酯骨架：苯环与含羰基的内酯环相连，环中有一个碘中心；碘中心还连有两个羟基样的 O-H 配体，并通过一个氧原子连接到右侧烯烃片段。右侧烯烃片段中，左侧烯碳带有 R1 取代基并连到 O-I，右侧烯碳连到带 R2、R3 和 H 的碳取代环境。推理：按方法稿将所有 R 取代基用通配符 * 表示，并忽略箭头。先从烯烃取代基开始，左外部 R 记为 *，C=C 及其立体斜线编码为 */C(=C/C(*)*)O。随后接上碘中心，碘连两个羟基并连到苯并碘氧杂内酯氧，写作 OI1(O)(O)O。最后把左侧稠合内酯/苯环编码为 C(=O)c2ccccc21，并用 1 与含碘环闭合。因此得到完整 SMILES：*/C(=C/C(*)*)OI1(O)(O)OC(=O)c2ccccc21。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct visual-to-graph transcription: it builds the target SMILES by reading the displayed connectivity from the drawing rather than using reaction inference or option elimination. This is the only strongly justified route for this open image-to-SMILES task.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the structure as a benziodoxolone transition-state drawing: a benzene-fused lactone/carboxylate ring on the left, carbonyl oxygen, ring oxygen bound to iodine, iodine also bearing two OH groups and an O substituent, and that O attached to an alkene fragment bearing R1 on the left vinylic carbon and R2/R3/H on the right carbon; ignore all curved arrows and dashed interaction marks as requested.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the answer should be a SMILES expression for the transition-state structure and that arrows must be ignored; no other textual chemical data are needed.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply standard skeletal-structure-to-SMILES conventions: unlabeled vertices are carbons, labeled O/I atoms are explicit, R groups are represented as wildcard dummy atoms `*`, aromatic benzene is encoded with lowercase `c`, ring closures must reproduce the benziodoxolone ring, iodine valence can be represented explicitly as `I1(O)(O)O...`, and the drawn alkene geometry is encoded with slash/backslash stereochemical markers.
